text:
maria: Hey — noticing a small but steady uptick in partial/unfinished streaming responses for /v1/stream from a few enterprise customers since last night. Chunks arrive, then connection closes before final event. Anyone know the best dashboards/logs to start with? :thinking:

alex: Start with Console -> Streaming -> "Chunk timing / gaps" dashboard (filters: model, region, client_id). Also check the error rate metric `stream.partial_rate` in Datadog; that usually correlates. For logs, Loki query below helps find client disconnects and server-side partial writes.

alex: ```
{app="redwood-stream"} |= "stream partial" or |= "connection closed" | json | line_format "${time} ${level} ${msg}"
```

jamal: +1. Also double-check ALB/NLB idle timeouts — we've seen ALB default 60s kill long gaps between chunks. If chunk intervals spike >60s the load balancer will close the socket and client sees a truncated stream.

piotr: Quick trace tip: if you can replicate, force sampling on a request by adding header `x-rt-trace: 1` and then look in Tempo/Jaeger under service `stream-proxy` -> search by trace id. That shows whether server emitted final event but it never reached the client.

observability-bot: Alert: STREAM_PARTIAL_RATE > 0.5% triggered for prod/us-east-1 at 2025-11-02T03:12:47Z — Incident: https://console.redwood.com/incidents/INC-20251102-17 (assigned to eng-runtime)

lee: If the server did send final event but client didn't get it, check client-side keepalive and proxy timeouts (NGINX 104 errors show up in logs). On server side, check for intermittent OOMs in container logs (`OOM killed`), or backpressure in the runtime (long GC or GPU timeouts).

maria: Can someone paste the PromQL / Datadog query you'd recommend for the alert? I want to open a PR to tune threshold + group by model/client so we don't flood on noisy tenants. I'll also attach a dashboard link in the PR.

alex: Suggested PromQL for alert (5m window):
```
(sum(rate(stream_partial_count[5m])) by (region, model)) / (sum(rate(stream_request_count[5m])) by (region, model)) > 0.005
```
Use `by(client_id, region, model)` for finer granularity and set `for: 10m` on pager alerts. For noisy tenants set mute rules. Also filter out internal health-checks.

jamal: I can own the alert tuning PR and the dashboard link. I'll also check infra (ALB vs NLB keepalive) and confirm if any recent deploy touched proxy timeouts. Assign to me pls. @maria ping me the affected client_ids and sample request ids.

maria: Thanks — will DM sample client_ids and a couple request IDs. FYI dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/d/streaming/chunk-timing (pinning would help). Also we should add an automatic log sampler that captures full request/response bodies for sampled traces for 1h when alert fires.

observability-bot: Done: pinned dashboard `streaming/chunk-timing` to #eng-runtime and created a short-lived tracing rule for alert INC-20251102-17 (sampling enabled for 1h).

lee: One more note — if you see many `write: broken pipe` / `EPIPE` in logs, that's client disconnects. If you see `connection reset by peer` across multiple workers at same time, suspect infra-level close (ALB/NLB) or proxy config.

piotr: After alert PR we should also add a small synthetic streaming check that requests a 5-minute stream with periodic chunks to catch long-gap issues before customers.

maria: Great plan. Thanks all — jamal please update here when PR is up and any infra findings. :thumbsup:
